message.content:
Below is a chronological list of **long‑weekend** periods in Canada for the year 2023.  
A long weekend is defined as a holiday that falls on a weekday (or is observed on a weekday) and creates an extended weekend (Saturday–Monday or Friday–Sunday).  

| Start Date | End Date | Holiday(s) | Notes |
|------------|----------|------------|-------|
| **Jan 1 – Jan 2** | New Year’s Day (observed on Monday Jan 2 because Jan 1 was a Sunday) | Federal | Creates a 2‑day weekend (Sunday–Monday). |
| **Feb 18 – Feb 20** | Family Day (observed on Monday Feb 20 in Alberta, British Columbia, Ontario, Saskatchewan) | Provincial | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Saturday–Monday). |
| **Apr 7 – Apr 9** | Good Friday (Friday) | Federal | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Friday–Sunday). |
| **May 20 – May 22** | Victoria Day (Monday) | Federal | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Saturday–Monday). |
| **Jul 1 – Jul 3** | Canada Day (observed on Monday Jul 3 because Jul 1 was a Saturday) | Federal | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Saturday–Monday). |
| **Sep 2 – Sep 4** | Labour Day (Monday) | Federal | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Saturday–Monday). |
| **Oct 7 – Oct 9** | Thanksgiving (Monday) | Federal | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Saturday–Monday). |
| **Nov 11 – Nov 13** | Remembrance Day (Friday) | Federal | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Friday–Sunday). |
| **Dec 23 – Dec 25** | Christmas Day (Monday) | Federal | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Saturday–Monday). |

### Provincial Holidays That Create Long Weekends (2023)

| Province | Holiday | Date | Long Weekend |
|----------|---------|------|--------------|
| British Columbia | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | Mar 15–17 (Saturday–Monday) |
| Manitoba | Louis Riel Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | Mar 15–17 (Saturday–Monday) |
| New Brunswick | Saint John’s Day | Jun 24 (Monday) | Jun 22–24 (Saturday–Monday) |
| Newfoundland & Labrador | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | Mar 15–17 (Saturday–Monday) |
| Nova Scotia | St. George’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | Mar 15–17 (Saturday–Monday) |
| Prince Edward Island | St. George’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | Mar 15–17 (Saturday–Monday) |
| Quebec | Saint Jean‑Baptiste Day | Jun 24 (Monday) | Jun 22–24 (Saturday–Monday) |
| Saskatchewan | Family Day | Feb 20 (Monday) | Feb 18–20 (Saturday–Monday) |

> **Note:** Some of these provincial holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day, Louis Riel Day, Saint John’s Day, Saint George’s Day, Saint Jean‑Baptiste Day) are observed only in specific provinces and do not affect the entire country.

Feel free to integrate this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need more detailed information about each holiday (history, significance, etc.) or want to filter by a particular province, let me know!
